contradictions.topic: Media Server Port Architecture and Collision Handling
conflicting_reports: Report 26 / Report 29 (claimed Port 6211 for Overlay Media Server)
Report 08 / Report 27 (claimed Port 3784 for WebSocket Server)
contradictions.investigation_method: CIL disassembly of StartAiServerLocal (0x060002a9), StartMediaServerCore (0x060007f3), and SyncMediaAndStartServer (0x060007f7)

debunked_5000_origin.value: PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL; PRAGMA synchronous=FULL; PRAGMA busy_timeout=5000;
debunked_5000_origin.explanation: Conflated in Phase 9 Report 29 with SQLite busy_timeout pragma parameter (5000 ms). No 5000-5050 port range exists in GGTT.dll.

contradictions.resolution: RESOLVED_EXACT: WebSocket operates on 3784. Media server derives its port dynamically as websocketport + 1 (base 3785) with up to 3 retries (3785 -> 3786 -> 3787 -> 3788). Port 6211 belongs exclusively to LocalAiFileServer. Port 5000-5050 is an erroneous artifact conflating SQLite busy_timeout.
contradictions.canonical_truth: WebSocket: 3784; Media Server: 3785 (+1 on collision, max 3 retries, bounds 3785..3788); AI Model Server: 6211.

contradictions.topic: Embedded Script Validation and SHA-256 Content Fingerprint
conflicting_reports: Report 17 / Report 20 (CLAIM-06: claimed SHA-256 verified against external whitelist/trust file)
Report 32 (CLM-07: claimed SHA-256 computed as internal content identity, not verified against whitelist)

checks.rule: Payload must not exceed 1,048,576 bytes (1 MB)

checks.il: IL_0021: ldc.i4 65279; call TrimStart; call Trim
checks.rule: Strips UTF-8 Byte Order Mark (0xFEFF / 65279) and leading/trailing whitespace

checks.il: IL_003c: ldstr 'error'; IL_004a: ldstr 'no-data'; IL_0058: ldstr '\A[a-fA-F0-9]{32}\z'
checks.rule: If payload matches 'error', 'no-data', or a 32-character hex error token, throws EmbeddedScriptException with Vietnamese denial message

checks.il: IL_007b: ToLowerInvariant; check application/javascript, text/javascript, application/x-javascript
checks.rule: Must match standard JavaScript MIME types
Throws InvalidResponse if script contains null bytes (0x00)

checks.il: IL_00e0: check communicate_launcher, TikLangJz/idus, TikeqID, regex \A\(\s*\(\s*\)\s*=>\s*\{
checks.rule: Validates mandatory script functions and identifiers

checks.il: IL_013b: call SHA256::HashData(byte[]); IL_0140: call Convert::ToHexString(byte[]); IL_0145: call ToLowerInvariant(); IL_014a: newobj GGTT.EmbeddedScript::.ctor(string, string)
checks.rule: Computes SHA-256 over raw downloaded bytes to instantiate immutable EmbeddedScript record; DOES NOT compare with external trust list

contradictions.resolution: RESOLVED_EXACT: EmbeddedScriptLoader.Validate computes SHA-256 as an immutable in-memory content identifier and integrity fingerprint for runtime tracking, NOT against an external whitelist. External RSA-2048 signature verification belongs exclusively to EffectProcessTrust (0x06000382) for OBS Named Pipe authentication.
contradictions.canonical_truth: SHA-256 in EmbeddedScriptLoader is a content-derived identity token; script trust is established structurally (size <= 1MB, no nulls, MIME, tokens, denial regex) rather than via a pre-shared hash whitelist.
